title: Mini Golf – 3-Hole Course
prompt:
Create a complete mini golf game in a single HTML file using Three.js (CDN). The game has a 3-hole course with increasing difficulty.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera starting at position (0, 12, 15) looking down at the first hole.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (10, 20, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Renderer should have antialiasing, shadow maps enabled, and fill the full viewport.
- Sky-blue background color (#87CEEB).

## Course Layout
All holes are flat green rectangles (fairways) with walls (brown BoxGeometry) as boundaries:

**Hole 1 (Par 2):** Simple straight fairway. Green rectangle 4 wide x 16 long, centered at x=0, z=0. Tee (start) at z=7, cup (hole) at z=-7. No obstacles.

**Hole 2 (Par 3):** L-shaped fairway. Starts 4 wide x 10 long at x=20, z=0, then turns right into a 10 wide x 4 long section. A rectangular obstacle block (1x0.5x1, red) sits in the corner of the L. Cup is at the far end of the L-turn.

**Hole 3 (Par 3):** Straight fairway 4 wide x 20 long at x=40, z=0. Has a windmill obstacle in the center: a vertical post with a rotating blade (2 arms, each 1.5 units long, rotating at 1.5 rad/s). Tee at z=9, cup at z=-9.

## Golf Ball
- White sphere, radius 0.2, with shadows. Starts at Hole 1 tee position.
- Physics: When hit, the ball moves with velocity, decelerating due to friction (multiply velocity by 0.985 each frame). Ball stops when speed < 0.01.
- Ball bounces off walls and obstacles with simple reflection (reverse the component of velocity perpendicular to the wall, multiply by 0.7 restitution).
- Ball-windmill collision: if the rotating blade hits the ball, deflect it sideways.

## Cup (Hole)
- Dark circle on the ground (radius 0.3, dark green or black). When the ball center is within 0.35 units of the cup center AND ball speed < 0.5, the ball is 'sunk'. Play a brief sinking animation (ball scales to 0 over 0.3s).

## Aiming & Shooting
- When the ball is stationary, show an aim arrow (a thin cone/arrow mesh) originating from the ball pointing in the aim direction.
- Mouse movement (mousemove) rotates the aim direction. Track the angle from the ball to the mouse projected onto the ground plane. The arrow points OPPOSITE to the mouse (you aim away from where you pull).
- A power bar (HTML div, 200px wide, 20px tall) at the bottom center of the screen fills up while the left mouse button is held down. Power increases from 0 to 1 over 2 seconds, then resets (ping-pong). The bar fill color goes from green (low) to red (high).
- On mouseup, launch the ball in the aim direction with speed = power * 15.
- While the ball is moving, aiming is disabled.

## Stroke Counter & HUD
- Top-left HUD (HTML overlay): show 'Hole: X/3', 'Strokes: Y', 'Par: Z', 'Total: W'.
- Each shot increments strokes for the current hole.
- When a hole is sunk, after 1 second, advance to the next hole: move ball to next tee, move camera to look at the new hole, reset hole strokes to 0.
- After hole 3 is sunk, show a results screen (centered HTML div with id='results-screen'): 'Course Complete! Total Strokes: W' and a 'Play Again' button (id='play-again-btn') that resets everything.

## Camera
- Camera follows the current hole. For each hole, position the camera at an overhead-angled view: (holeX, 12, holeZ + 12) looking at (holeX, 0, holeZ).
- Smooth camera transition (lerp over 1 second) when changing holes.

## State Management
Expose `window.__3D_STATE__` with these fields updated every frame:
- `ballPosition`: {x, y, z} current ball position
- `ballVelocity`: {x, y, z} current ball velocity
- `ballSpeed`: number, magnitude of velocity
- `ballMoving`: boolean, true if ball speed >= 0.01
- `currentHole`: number (1, 2, or 3)
- `holeStrokes`: number, strokes taken on current hole
- `totalStrokes`: number, cumulative strokes across all holes
- `holePar`: number, par for current hole (2, 3, 3)
- `holeSunk`: boolean, true if ball just sunk into current hole
- `power`: number 0-1, current power bar charge
- `aimAngle`: number in radians, current aim direction
- `gameComplete`: boolean, true after all 3 holes finished
- `windmillAngle`: number, current rotation angle of windmill blade in radians
- `resultsVisible`: boolean, true if results screen is displayed
- `ballRadius`: 0.2
- `holePositions`: array of {x, z} for each hole's cup position

## Animation Loop
- Use requestAnimationFrame. Update ball physics, windmill rotation, friction, collisions, and state each frame.
- Windmill blade rotates continuously regardless of game state.
physics_constraints: Ball decelerates by friction factor 0.985/frame. Wall restitution coefficient 0.7. Ball sinks when distance to cup < 0.35 and speed < 0.5. Power range [0,1] maps to launch speed [0,15]. Windmill rotates at 1.5 rad/s continuously. Ball must stay within course boundaries at all times.
